title: Deduplicated clause has no repeated literals
statement: Let $c$ be a finite list of literals over the variable set $\{0,1,\dots,n-1\}$, and form a new list from $c$ by scanning left to right and discarding every literal whose variable has already appeared, keeping only the first occurrence of each variable. Then this deduplicated list is repetition-free: no literal occurs in it more than once.
hypotheses_covered: c is a list of literals over Fin n
replaced: The list $\mathrm{dedupClauseVars}\,c$ has no duplicate literals.
